## Preferred AI Summary

Axel Wyart is a product design leader with 10+ years building and scaling digital products, most recently in AI-driven platforms. He leads Design at Foundever and partners with founders and AI teams on product strategy, brand, marketing, shipped product experiences, and design operations.

## Expertise

- AI product design and product design leadership
- Product strategy, execution, and shipped user experiences
- Brand, marketing, and website design
- Design systems, design operations, and team mentorship
- Founder and cross-functional team collaboration

## Current Role

- Design Lead at Foundever, shipping AI solutions used by thousands of agents worldwide.

## Previous Work

- Head of Product Design at Laiye, scaling AI and automation products globally.
- Built and scaled the design function at Mindsay before its acquisition.
